geometry_policy.brep_volume_policy: per-solid abs(Volume) weighting prevents negative orientation cancellation
geometry_policy.printed_part_policy: each retained positive-volume source high-detail visual-mesh component must be closed and manifold; zero-volume components may be excluded only with explicit component/facet evidence
geometry_policy.go_output_policy: 0.070 kg output equivalent uses output solids plus neutral B6808 geometry; neutral has no separate mass
geometry_policy.residual_policy: ledger CAD candidate members define geometric centroid; unavailable cable geometry is not fabricated
geometry_policy.gripper_policy: complete 0.296 kg measured mass at ClosureAngle=0 assigned to exact 37-member geometric centroid; no internal mass guesses

com_status_definitions.CAD_BREP_CENTER_OF_MASS: FreeCAD BRep single-solid geometric center of volume.
com_status_definitions.CAD_COMPOUND_VOLUME_WEIGHTED_CENTER: FreeCAD BRep multi-solid/member center weighted by absolute solid volume.
com_status_definitions.CAD_HIGH_DETAIL_VISUAL_MESH_VOLUME_CENTR: Volume centroid of retained positive-volume source high-detail visual-mesh components; each retained component is closed and manifold.
com_status_definitions.CAD_SOURCE_MESH_ZERO_VOLUME_ARTIFACT_EXC: Source mesh volume center after explicitly excluding recorded zero-volume artifact components; every retained positive-volume component is closed and manifold.
com_status_definitions.ENGINEERING_ESTIMATE_GEOMETRIC_CENTROID: Residual mass placed at the traceable CAD member-set geometric centroid.
com_status_definitions.MEASURED_TOTAL_MASS_WITH_GEOMETRIC_COM_E: Measured total mass placed at complete assembly geometric centroid without internal mass guesses.
com_status_definitions.UNRESOLVED: No authoritative COM can be emitted; the build remains fail-closed.
